Definition: adverb from G4253; at dawn; by implication, the day-break watch:--early (in the morning), (in the) morning.
BiblicalUsage: Proi means early in the morning, at dawn. Mark says the women came to the sepulchre very early in the morning, and John says Mary came early, when it was yet dark.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the dawn belongs to the resurrection, and the women who came early found the stone already rolled away.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
